title: PHOSPHONATE AND PHOSPHINATE COMPOUNDS AS GLUCOKINASE ACTIVATORS
abstract: Compounds are provided which are phosphonate and phosphinate activators and thus are useful in treating diabetes and related diseases and have the structure of Formula (I), wherein Formula (II) is a heteroaryl ring; Ris -(CH)-Z-(CH)-PO(OR)(OR), -(CH)Z-(CH)-PO(OR)R, -(CH)Z-(CH)-OPO(OR)R, -(CH)Z-(CH)-OPO(OR)R) or -(CH)Z-(CH)-PO(OR)R); Rand RR6 are independently selected from H, alkyl and halogen; Y is R(CH)s or is absent; and X, n, Z, m, R, R, R, R, and s are as defined herein; or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof. A method for treating diabetes and related diseases employing the above compounds is also provided.
